title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.59 (versions follow prime numbers; 359 after 353): the grandparent names the grandchild its parent's sibling. Request 46, asked only by an ancestor above the parent (neither the child nor its parent can), makes a process a child of its parent's parent, so it outlives its parent; what waited for the parent's signature waits for the new parent's, and its porters do not change (naming gives life, not power). Without it, a parent's line now ends with it. The kernel, highest of all, names the children of the processes it launched itself, so a mother that leaves her boxes and goes still works. The parent's shadow sleeps, kept. Tested in a copy of the project (family, boxes and Venn: 102 passing); the full kernel suite was not run. Also her contours, traced where she is made bigger: one routine, each time her screen is doubled (her forms, then the whole screen), gives each quarter of a dot the colour of the side its edge runs along (Scale2x), so staircases become slants and curves, in her forms, creatures and music view alike. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.59: el abuelo nombra al nieto, y sus contornos con curvas. Prototipo de investigación.
